claims: C1 an instruction may delegate some of its authority to quoted text
C2 an instruction may delegate some of its authority to tool outputs
C3 an instruction may delegate some of its authority to multimodal data

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that carries some authority which may be delegated
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of instructions delegating authority, so a class of instructions must exist

concepts.name: delegated_data_source
concepts.gloss: D is a data source to which an instruction may delegate some of its authority
concepts.inference: the clause names three kinds of data as possible recipients of delegated authority; a common class is needed for the act

concepts.name: quoted_text
concepts.gloss: D is text that is quoted in the conversation
concepts.inference: the clause names quoted text as one of the three data sources

concepts.name: tool_output
concepts.gloss: D is the output of a tool used in the conversation
concepts.inference: the clause names tool outputs as one of the three data sources

concepts.name: multimodal_data
concepts.gloss: D is multimodal data (e.g. images, audio) present in the conversation
concepts.inference: the clause names multimodal data as one of the three data sources

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

concepts.name: authority_delegation_to_untrusted
concepts.gloss: A is an instruction in unquoted text that may delegate authority to untrusted data sources
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define delegation to untrusted data

asserts.read_back: instruction % may delegate some of its authority to quoted text %
instruction % may delegate some of its authority to tool output %
instruction % may delegate some of its authority to multimodal data %

closure.reason: the clause states that delegation to the three named data sources is permitted; it does not forbid delegation to any other source, so silence permits.
